Remark
[Strong convergence of reduced-distance gradients] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0165 ↗ thm:chow-iv-singular-time-reduced-distance-limit 1. ch30:30.12\group Singular-Time Reduced Distance

The proof gives $| abla \widetilde\ell _i|^2_{\Phi _i^*g_i} o | abla \ell _\infty |^2_{g_\infty }$ in distributions. Together with weak $W^{1,2}_{\mathrm{loc}}$ convergence, this identifies the limiting quadratic gradient term in the reduced-distance inequality.
